To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

software productivity improvement can be achieved, and can be achieved at an acceptable cost, by an industry-wide effort that is supported by the government, and that is focused on the development of software engineering technology.
the software productivity of the aerospace industry can be significantly improved by a consortium approach.
the Software Productivity Consortium has the potential to significantly reduce the cost of producing software and improve software quality.
In summary, our research is concerned with

(a) identifying the key issues and the most effective approaches to improving software productivity and quality; (b) developing and validating new software development methods, tools, and technologies; (c) developing a comprehensive set of software productivity and quality metrics; (d) developing a comprehensive data base on software productivity and quality and the factors that influence them; (e) providing a mechanism for the transfer of technology to the software development community.
the development of software technology that will enable the software development community to improve the productivity, reliability, and cost effectiveness of the software development process.
the following issues: (a) How to improve the productivity of mission- critical software?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Consortium's mission is to improve the quality, productivity, and reliability of mission-critical computer software.
the SPC is an industry-sponsored, not-for-profit organization that has been established to improve the productivity, reliability, and quality of mission- critical software.
the SPC will not solve the software productivity problem, but it will make a major contribution.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the SPC is a highly successful, self-sustaining organization that is achieving its goals.
the SPC is an industry initiative to improve productivity and quality of the software used in mission-critical applications.
the SPC has made substantial progress toward achieving its objectives.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the SPC is an effective vehicle for addressing a broad range of software productivity issues.
the Consortium model can work for the right problem.
the consortium approach is a viable one for attacking software problems of a national scope.
